description: Create a template (omit template_id) or update one (every plan). Changing the markdown saves a new version; older versions are kept. Use {{ variable_name }} placeholders for values that change per document, e.g. [[signature: {{ client_name }} <{{ client_email }}>]].

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

description.description: Short note on what the template is for, shown in the template list.

markdown.description: Full template markdown. Required when creating.

template_id.description: Omit to create a new template.

name: save_template
title: Save a template
